key_insight: VQE ansatz selection involves a trade-off: ADAPT-VQE approaches UCCSD accuracy with lower resource overhead, while hardware-efficient ansätze reduce hardware costs but sacrifice accuracy.
engineering_relevance: Near-term quantum chemistry implementations must balance circuit depth, parameter count, accuracy, and optimization difficulty rather than select an ansatz on hardware cost alone.
method: Benchmark UCCSD, fermionic ADAPT-VQE, BasicPCA, and Excitation Preserving ansätze.
Compare electronic-structure calculations for H₂, LiH, and N₂.
Evaluate circuit depth, parameter count, ground-state energy error, and NISQ feasibility.
evidence_signal: Across the tested molecules, ADAPT-VQE delivers accuracy comparable to UCCSD with lower overhead, but increasing circuit complexity makes it impractical around 10 electrons.
watch_item: Hardware-efficient ansatz performance depends strongly on molecular size; the Excitation Preserving ansatz fails for N₂, limiting extrapolation from smaller systems.
paper_title: A Unified Benchmarking Study of Variational Quantum Eigensolver Ansatz for Electronic Structure Problems
